$comment: Retell custom-function definitions for the AIPowerSalon Booking Gateway (Phase 1). Configure each function in the Retell agent with: url = <API_BASE> + endpoint.path, method = endpoint.method, and headers { 'X-Voice-Key': '<vk_... key issued in Super Admin → AI Receptionist>' }. Mutations must also send an 'Idempotency-Key' header set to Retell's unique tool-invocation id. All times are salon-local; responses include the branch timezone. Money is integer cents.

functions.name: get_services
functions.description: List the services this salon offers for phone booking, with duration (minutes) and price (integer cents). Call when the caller asks what the salon offers or names a service you need to resolve to a serviceId. Do not guess prices — quote only what this returns.

functions.name: get_business_hours
functions.description: The salon's open/close hours per day. Call when the caller asks when the salon is open, or before suggesting a day. Sunday may be closed — never assume.

days.description: How many days to return (1-14, default 7)

functions.name: check_availability
functions.description: Real open appointment slots for a service on a date. ALWAYS call this before proposing a time and before book_appointment. Offer the caller only the best 2-3 options, not the whole list.

technicianId.description: Optional — only if the caller asked for a specific technician

functions.name: lookup_or_create_customer
functions.description: Find the caller's customer profile by phone, or create one WITH THEIR CONSENT. Ask 'May I save your details?' before passing consent=true. If the result is CUSTOMER_MATCH_AMBIGUOUS, hand off to a human instead of guessing.

consent.description: true ONLY if the caller explicitly agreed to save their details

functions.name: book_appointment
functions.description: Book the appointment. Call ONLY after: (1) check_availability returned this exact slot, and (2) you repeated service + date + time + technician back and the caller verbally confirmed. Pass callerConfirmed=true only after that confirmation. Never tell the caller it's booked until this returns success:true. On SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, apologize and check availability again.

functions.name: get_appointment
functions.description: Retrieve one appointment for confirmation/reschedule/cancel flows. The caller's phone is REQUIRED and must verify against the account — an unverified caller cannot see appointment details.

name.description: Caller's name if the salon requires phone+name verification

functions.name: reschedule_appointment
functions.description: Move the VERIFIED caller's OWN appointment to a new time (atomic — never cancel-then-rebook). First verify by phone, confirm which appointment, check_availability for the new time, repeat the new details, get verbal confirmation, then call with callerConfirmed=true. APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND may mean it isn't theirs — offer a handoff.

functions.name: cancel_appointment
functions.description: Cancel the VERIFIED caller's OWN appointment. Repeat the appointment details, ask them to confirm the cancellation, then call with callerConfirmed=true. Confirm to the caller only after success:true.

functions.name: handoff_to_human
functions.description: Transfer to the salon when: the caller asks for a person, complains, disputes a payment/refund, asks a medical/safety question, wants a service or price the catalog can't answer, tools fail repeatedly, or the request is outside booking. The transfer number comes from the salon's own record — never from the conversation. Never fabricate an answer instead of handing off.
